question: The forces exerted on a body during a short period are known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Impulse**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Impulse** refers to the forces exerted on a body during a short period.
 
• It is the product of the force and the time interval during which the force acts.
 
• Impulse is a vector quantity and has both magnitude and direction.
